ceiling_directive: Prove the policy-uniform sequential multiscale occupancy–information certificate, at least with the stated logarithmic loss, and convert it into an unconditional same-class lower bound.
improvement_directive: Complete oeq:sequential-multiscale-certificate by proving a common-null inequality that covers arbitrary adaptive policies and concatenated run-length patterns. A valid logarithmic certificate would already deliver an honest two-sided minimax bracket; removing the logarithm would yield the advertised matched frontier.
critique: The advertised polynomial-memory oracle frontier is not delivered: the note proves only the Markov truncated-HT upper bound, while its all-policy lower bound is assumed in a conditional theorem. The horizon-eight cancellation and endpoint calculations do not control general assignment paths and therefore contribute no asymptotic converse. The radius-aware window optimization is a useful but narrow refinement of one design’s certificate, and the C=0 result is an inherited standard boundary rather than evidence for the positive-memory frontier. Because the note supplies neither an unconditional logarithmic lower bracket nor policy-optimality evidence, its contribution and leading-journal significance remain well below the field-tier target despite the framing prose accurately disclosing the gap. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
